title: Cutaway Core System
description: A four-image continuity series built around one engineered object and increasingly revealing its internal architecture.
creative_direction: Image 01 defines one original engineered object as a poster-grade hero. Images 02-04 depend on it and preserve the exact subject identity while introducing progressively deeper cutaway and section treatments.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-context-shift, 03-surface-study, 04-presentation-master. Queue may run later images concurrently after 01-reference-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
